about: Pinned toolchain for the release payload. fetch_toolchain.py downloads each entry, checks its SHA-256 and unpacks it under work/release/toolchain-cache/; assemble_payload.py --toolchain copies the trees into payload toolchain/ and the licence texts into licenses/<group>/. '{version}' and '{llvm}' in a URL are this entry's own fields. sha256 TO-FILL = never fetched: fetch_toolchain.py refuses it unless --fill (record the hash on first fetch, check the release page's published hash where one exists). pin TO-CONFIRM = the version was chosen offline (release pass 8, no network): check the release page for the current release first, edit 'version' (and 'llvm'), then --fill.

build_tools.name: innosetup
build_tools.about: Build-time only (never shipped): the official Inno Setup installer, hash-checked by .github/workflows/release.yml and tools/release/wizard_test.sh before a silent install. Hash taken from the copy in work/release/r13/dl fetched 2026-10-12 (source assumed files.jrsoftware.org; the KZ3-02 round had no --net); re-confirm against a fresh download when the version changes.
